mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, just take a moment and let this sink in—walking the path of untaming isn’t a one-time leap. It’s a practice you carry with you, a way of living that invites you to question, to listen, to really feel, and to choose—again and again. Sure, it’s not always easy. But every step really is worth it. So, as you set out from here, hold on to a few gentle reminders: Your inner voice? It’s wise—so trust it, even if it feels unfamiliar at first. Sometimes, honoring your own truth means letting someone else down—and that’s okay. Remember, joy and pleasure aren’t just nice-to-haves; they’re essential for a full and vibrant life. If you’re grieving, let yourself feel it. Grief is proof of love, and healing follows when you give yourself that space. And, above all, self-compassion is what makes real, lasting change possible. Here’s something important—you're not walking this path alone. Every person who chooses to live untamed is lighting the way for someone else. There’ll be days when you feel lost or when those old rules start tugging you back. You might even hear that whisper of fear, telling you it’s safer to stay small. On those days, come back to your breath, to your body, to that quiet knowing deep inside. You don’t need to have it all figured out. You don’t have to be perfect, or fearless, or endlessly strong. All you really need is the willingness to listen, to try, and to start again when you need to. The world needs your wildness, your honesty, your hope. When you choose to live untamed, you’re giving everyone around you permission to do the same. So, take that next step—even if it’s a small one. Trust that your life is yours to shape. And know that freedom—in all its messy, beautiful forms—is always within reach.
